title: Box Office: Jan Neta Struggles, Dhamaal 4 Is A Winner
summary: Dhamaal 4 continues to dominate the Indian box office, adding about Rs 15 crore in its third week and crossing roughly Rs 157 crore overall. The Hindi-dubbed Vijay film Jana Nayagan, released as Jan Neta, underperformed with a four-day opening near Rs 7 crore and a projected lifetime of Rs 15–17 crore. Several other recent Hindi releases fared disastrously.
content:
Jan Neta struggles at the box office while Dhamaal 4 continues its impressive run.

Two weeks after its release, Dhamaal 4 continues to dominate the theatres. In its third week, around Rs 15 crore (Rs 150 million) have come in. It did better than the Thursday before, then doubled up on Saturday to cross the Rs 5 crore (Rs 50 million) mark and posted further growth on Sunday. That performance indicates strong acceptance among family audiences.

Meanwhile, the Hindi-dubbed version of Vijay's Jana Nayagan, released as Jan Neta, has not done well. The film posted a low four-day extended weekend of around Rs 7 crore* (Rs 70 million). Despite a wide Hindi release, occupancy remains low. First-week collections are estimated at around Rs 10 crore (Rs 100 million). Some additional revenue will trickle in thereafter, but lifetime collections are likely to be in the Rs 15 crore to Rs 17 crore (Rs 150 million to Rs 170 million) range at best.

Other Hindi releases of the week — The India Story, Tera Yaar Hoon Main and Dulhaniya Le Aaeegi — performed disastrously. The India Story is a docudrama, Tera Yaar Hoon Main is a dated love story and Dulhaniya Le Aaeegi is a delayed comedy of errors. Even combined, the collections of these three films did not touch Rs 1 crore (Rs 10 million). None of them are expected to find significant showcasing in a second week.

Indra Kumar's Dhamaal 4 has crossed the Rs 150 crore (Rs 1.5 billion) milestone and currently stands around Rs 157 crore* (Rs 1.57 billion). This is notable given the lack of big Hindi releases immediately ahead. Titles such as Batwara 1947 and Awarapan 2 are scheduled to arrive around Independence Day.

*Estimates. Note: All collections are according to various box office sources.

Photographs curated by Satish Bodas/Rediff.
